usedFor: Adafruit IO holds device readings, and Asana receives a task when “New Feed Data” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Feed Data” in Adafruit IO, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A fresh reading becomes an Asana task with an assignee and dates, so someone owns the follow-up.

watchOut: “New Feed Data” is polling, so “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana trails the reading by one check.
